lessons.culture: The post office is called "البوستة" in Cairo speech, and you send letters and parcels at the window, where the clerk weighs the parcel to set the price. challenge.title: A morning of errands
challenge.instructions: Write and act out a conversation of at least 10 lines in Egyptian Arabic in which you withdraw cash at the bank, ask the cost of sending a parcel at the post office, and top up your phone balance, asking for directions between the stops. Use at least 8 target phrases from Unit 19.
required_elements: A request at the bank such as عايز أسحب فلوس or عايزة أسحب فلوس.
A question about where the post office is with فين, such as البوستة فين؟
A question about a price with بكام or كام, such as الشحن بكام؟
A request to top up the phone balance such as عايز أشحن رصيد.
A polite word such as لو سمحت or شكراً.
